"""Frozen redirect decisions of the pinned httpx (BSD-3-Clause, encode/httpx at b5addb64).

python -I httpx_redirect_oracle.py <httpx checkout at b5addb64> <out.json>
For every (request URL, status, Location) case: whether httpx follows it
(Response.has_redirect_location), and the URL Client._redirect_url builds, or the error it
raises. GET only: ECDEV never sends another method, so _redirect_method is not exercised.
Nothing is sent over a network; the donor's request and response models are built in memory.
"""
import hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys

checkout = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(); out = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
COMMIT = "b5addb64f0161ff6bfe94c124ef76f6a1fba5254"
assert subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(checkout), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip() == COMMIT
sys.path.insert(0, str(checkout))
import httpx
assert pathlib.Path(httpx.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(checkout), httpx.__file__

BASES = [
    "https://www.example.com/a/b/c?x=1",
    "https://www.example.com/a/b/c?x=1#frag",
    "http://shop.example.jp/item/123",
    "https://example.com",
    "https://example.com:8443/p/",
]
LOCATIONS = [
    None, "", "https://www.example.org/next", "http://www.example.com/a/b/c", "//cdn.example.net/x",
    "/abs/path", "rel", "../up", "./dot", "?q=only", "#f", "http:/nohost", "https:path",
    "https://example.com/a b", "https://bücher.example/p", "/ü/path", "https://example.com/%7Euser",
    "https://user:pw@example.com/", "https://example.com/?token=abc", "https://example.com/?q=a%20b&q=c",
    "ftp://example.com/f", "javascript:alert(1)", "https://example.com:443/x", "http://example.com:80/x",
    "https://EXAMPLE.com/X", "/a/../b/./c", "https://[::1]/", "https://127.0.0.1/", "//", "///triple",
    "https://example.com/#new", "/path#new", "\\\\backslash\\\\path", "https://example.com/p?",
    "https://example.com/p/../q", "HTTPS://Example.COM/Case", "https://xn--bcher-kva.example/p",
    "https://example.com:99999/", "http://exa mple.com/", "/search?k=caf%C3%A9&page=2",
]
STATUSES = [200, 300, 301, 302, 303, 304, 305, 306, 307, 308]

client = httpx.Client()
cases = []
for base in BASES:
    for status in STATUSES:
        for loc in LOCATIONS:
            request = httpx.Request("GET", base)
            headers = {} if loc is None else {"Location": loc}
            try:
                response = httpx.Response(status, headers=headers, request=request)
            except Exception as e:  # header values httpx refuses to carry
                cases.append({"base": base, "status": status, "location": loc, "follows": None, "error": type(e).__name__})
                continue
            follows = response.has_redirect_location
            case = {"base": base, "status": status, "location": loc, "follows": follows}
            if follows:
                try:
                    case["target"] = str(client._redirect_url(request, response))
                except Exception as e:
                    case["error"] = type(e).__name__
            cases.append(case)
generator = pathlib.Path(__file__).read_bytes()
out.write_text(json.dumps({"donor_id": "encode--httpx", "commit_sha": COMMIT, "license": "BSD-3-Clause",
    "license_blob": subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(checkout), "rev-parse", f"{COMMIT}:LICENSE.md"], text=True).strip(),
    "oracle": "UNMODIFIED_DONOR_MODELS_IN_MEMORY", "max_redirects": httpx._config.DEFAULT_MAX_REDIRECTS,
    "generator_sha256": hashlib.sha256(generator).hexdigest(), "generator_source": generator.decode(),
    "cases": cases}, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
print(len(cases), "cases", sum(1 for c in cases if c.get("follows")), "followed")
